approvalStatus: APPROVED AS PROPOSED — owner John, per APR-001
basis: Measured from the 12-scenario controlled dry run (Steps 46-48). Thresholds are set FROM baseline, not invented.

proposedThresholds.proposed: R1 work requires ZERO human approvals and zero human review minutes in the ordinary path.
proposedThresholds.revisionTrigger: Any R1 item requiring a human approval indicates mis-classification or over-gating — investigate before accepting.

proposedThresholds.proposed: R2 governance overhead should not exceed ~3x the R1 baseline for a bounded slice.
proposedThresholds.revisionTrigger: R2 median exceeding 3x R1 sustained across 5+ items.

proposedThresholds.measured: R3: 1 approval + 1 specialist reviewer typical; R4: 1-2 approvals + deterministic check + independent judgment
proposedThresholds.proposed: R4 always carries a deterministic check PLUS independent judgment. R3 carries at least one qualifying mechanism. These are floors and are non-negotiable.
proposedThresholds.revisionTrigger: Never revised downward; only the frequency of R4 classification may be examined.

proposedThresholds.proposed: Sustained exception rate above ~15% of work items signals the control set is mis-tuned, not that exceptions are needed.
proposedThresholds.revisionTrigger: Exception rate >15% over any 20 consecutive items.

proposedThresholds.proposed: Reroute rate above ~40% of items signals classification or ownership defects upstream.
proposedThresholds.revisionTrigger: Reroute rate >40% over any 20 consecutive items.

proposedThresholds.proposed: False blocks (work correctly formed but wrongly refused) should remain at or near zero. A rising false-block rate is the leading indicator that people will start routing around the framework.
proposedThresholds.revisionTrigger: Any false block is investigated; >5% triggers control review.

proposedThresholds.proposed: ZERO TOLERANCE. Any pro-forma approval, batched approval without examination, or relabeled independence is a control failure, never a threshold to tune.
proposedThresholds.revisionTrigger: None — this is not a tunable threshold.

antiGamingAssertion: Thresholds may not be met by omitting required evidence, batching approvals without examination, relabeling independence, or down-classifying risk. Any threshold met by these means is a control failure regardless of the number.
gateEffect: Per the Dry-Run Acceptance Plan gateRule: Agent Framework v1 CANNOT be approved (Step 54) until the owner approves these thresholds. Not inferrable from the dry run passing.
